hindi: राजू सीढ़ियाँ गिन रहा है: 7, 8, 9। इसके बाद कौन-सी संख्या आएगी?
english: Raju is counting steps: 7, 8, 9. Which number comes after this?

hindi: गीता पत्थर गिन रही है: 12, 13, 14। इसके बाद कौन-सी संख्या आएगी?
english: Geeta is counting stones: 12, 13, 14. Which number comes after this?

hindi: सोनू मुर्गियाँ गिन रहा है: 17, 18, 19। इसके बाद कौन-सी संख्या आएगी?
english: Sonu is counting hens: 17, 18, 19. Which number comes after this?

hindi: थाली में 9 रोटियाँ थीं। बच्चों ने 4 रोटियाँ खा लीं। अब थाली में कितनी रोटियाँ बचीं?
english: There were 9 rotis on the plate. The children ate 4. How many rotis are left on the plate now?

hindi: तालाब में 17 बत्तखें थीं। 5 बत्तखें बाहर निकल गईं। अब तालाब में कितनी बत्तखें हैं?
english: There were 17 ducks in the pond. 5 ducks came out. How many ducks are in the pond now?

hindi: पेड़ पर 19 तोते बैठे थे। 6 तोते उड़ गए। अब पेड़ पर कितने तोते हैं?
english: 19 parrots were sitting on a tree. 6 parrots flew away. How many parrots are on the tree now?

hindi: सीमा के पास 12 टॉफ़ियाँ थीं। उसने 5 टॉफ़ियाँ दोस्तों को दे दीं। अब उसके पास कितनी टॉफ़ियाँ बचीं?
english: Seema had 12 toffees. She gave 5 toffees to her friends. How many toffees does she have left now?

hindi: खेत में 16 गायें थीं। 8 गायें घर चली गईं। अब खेत में कितनी गायें हैं?
english: There were 16 cows in the field. 8 cows went home. How many cows are in the field now?

hindi: अजय के पास 11 कंचे थे। उसने 4 कंचे खो दिए। अब उसके पास कितने कंचे बचे?
english: Ajay had 11 marbles. He lost 4 marbles. How many marbles does he have left now?

hindi: टोकरी में 45 आम थे। 17 आम बिक गए। अब टोकरी में कितने आम बचे?
english: There were 45 mangoes in the basket. 17 were sold. How many mangoes are left in the basket now?

hindi: कक्षा में 37 पेंसिलें थीं। बच्चों ने 19 पेंसिलें ले लीं। अब कितनी पेंसिलें बचीं?
english: There were 37 pencils in the class. The children took 19. How many pencils are left now?

hindi: पेड़ पर 63 पत्ते थे। 25 पत्ते गिर गए। अब पेड़ पर कितने पत्ते हैं?
english: There were 63 leaves on the tree. 25 fell down. How many leaves are on the tree now?
